fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. The LORD says, "I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth…" (Genesis 6:7). Then He adds that He is grieved that He made them. I think that's the part to sit with. The text says He was grieved in His heart (Genesis 6:6), and that makes this verse hit harder.
